whyItMatters: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a build that switches dependency locking off.
actions: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a build that switches dependency locking off.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm build.gradle no longer carries a build that switches dependency locking off.
